title: Sheep Eat Wolves
statementMd:
Farmer John has 𝑥x sheep and one day, 𝑦y wolves came to the river where he was herding the sheep.

For safety reasons, Farmer John wants to immediately transport all 𝑥x sheep back to his house on the other side of the river. There is a boat on the riverbank that Farmer John can use to transport up to 𝑝p animals with him at a time. Farmer John can only use this boat to transport animals back and forth between the two riverbanks.

However, if there is a group of animals that are not under Farmer John's supervision, and this group includes both wolves and sheep, and the number of wolves is strictly greater than the number of sheep plus 𝑞q, the wolves will eat the sheep. A group of animals can be under Farmer John's supervision if and only if they are on the boat or on the same side of the river as Farmer John.

Now Farmer John wants to know the minimum number of trips required to safely transport all the sheep back to his house on the other side of the river, or determine if it is impossible.

## Input

The only line contains four integers, 𝑥x (1≤𝑥≤1001≤x≤100) denoting the number of sheep, 𝑦y (1≤𝑦≤1001≤y≤100) denoting the number of wolves, 𝑝p (1≤𝑝≤1001≤p≤100) denoting the maximum number of animals that can be transported in one trip with Farmer John, and 𝑞q (0≤𝑞≤1000≤q≤100) denoting the threshold at which the wolves will eat the sheep when the number of wolves in a group not under Farmer John's supervision is strictly greater than the number of sheep plus 𝑞q.

## Output

Output a line containing a single integer, indicating the minimum number of trips required to safely transport all 𝑥x sheep back to Farmer John's house on the other side of the river. If it is impossible to safely transport all 𝑥x sheep back home, output −1−1 in one line.

## Note

statementZhMd:
Farmer John 有 𝑥x 只羊。一天，𝑦y 只狼来到了他放羊的河边。

出于安全考虑，Farmer John 想立即将全部 𝑥x 只羊运回位于河对岸的家中。河岸边有一艘船，Farmer John 每次可以用它随身运送至多 𝑝p 只动物。Farmer John 只能使用这艘船在两岸之间往返运送动物。

然而，如果一群动物不在 Farmer John 的看管之下，且其中既有狼也有羊，同时狼的数量严格大于羊的数量加上 𝑞q，那么狼就会吃掉羊。一群动物受到 Farmer John 看管，当且仅当它们在船上，或与 Farmer John 位于河的同一岸。

现在，Farmer John 想知道，将所有羊安全运回河对岸的家中最少需要多少次航行，或者判断这是否无法做到。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含四个整数：𝑥x（1≤𝑥≤1001≤x≤100），表示羊的数量；𝑦y（1≤𝑦≤1001≤y≤100），表示狼的数量；𝑝p（1≤𝑝≤1001≤p≤100），表示每次航行时 Farmer John 最多可以随身运送的动物数量；以及 𝑞q（0≤𝑞≤1000≤q≤100），表示狼吃羊的数量阈值：当一群不在 Farmer John 看管之下的动物中，狼的数量严格大于羊的数量加上 𝑞q 时，狼就会吃掉羊。

## 输出格式

输出一行，包含一个整数，表示将全部 𝑥x 只羊安全运回 Farmer John 位于河对岸的家中所需的最少航行次数。如果无法将全部 𝑥x 只羊安全运回家，则在一行中输出 −1−1。
